IGNITE 30 — illustrative nutrition framework
Fictional PulseUp Fitness concept. General educational example, not personalized nutrition or medical advice.

Build a flexible meal:
• Choose a protein source you enjoy: beans, tofu, eggs, fish or another suitable option.
• Add vegetables or fruit, grains or another carbohydrate, and a fat source.
• Keep water accessible. Adapt portions and choices to your own needs.
• Swap ingredients for allergies, dietary preferences, budget and availability.

Sample grocery list: oats, rice, lentils, tofu, leafy greens, seasonal fruit, olive oil.
Sample meal: rice bowl with lentils, roasted vegetables and a dressing you like.

This static demo provides no individual calorie or macro prescription.
Consult a qualified professional for individual dietary or exercise needs.
